text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I am quite surprised.
Trainer-san, you are quite skilled at crane games, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Looks like that mountain training paid off!
Looks like that mountain training really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training is that supposed to be, and from what era?!
...Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm honestly really happy
you caught so many for me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, it's proof that you took me seriously,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
So I'll be taking care of
every single one of these little guys.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: When I need speed, I pray to this one; when I need smarts, to that one. I rotate between them every day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "If I asked Believe-san, I wonder if she'd make me a nice shelf...?"
